title: Evaluating Reasoning Faithfulness in Medical Vision-Language Models using Multimodal Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: Introducing controlled multimodal perturbations, including text hints (e.g., a simulated radiologist's opinion or leaked answers) and visual cues (e.g., bounding boxes or heatmaps), to observe if the model's answer changes (flips) and whether its chain-of-thought reasoning faithfully attributes its decision to these injected biases.
